section.name: Migrating from HtmlUnit 2.x.x to HtmlUnit 3.x.x
section.p: HtmlUnit 3 represents the transition to the new htmlunit.org domain. For this purpose, the Maven group IDs for HtmlUnit and its subprojects (core-js, neko, cssparser, and xpath) were updated. Additionally, all package names have been unified under org.htmlunit.

subsection.name: 1. Adjust Maven group ID to org.htmlunit
2. Adjust package names in your source code
subsection.p: Replace all usages of com.gargoylesoftware.htmlunit with org.htmlunit.
Replace all usages of net.sourceforge.htmlunit with org.htmlunit.

subsection.name: 3. Update input control value access
subsection.p: Replace all usages of org.htmlunit.html.HtmlInput.getValueAttribute() with org.htmlunit.html.HtmlInput.getValue().
